claim: Fresh derived-timing seed 990022 qualified the recovered front end and then stopped at an unexpected battle on Route 2 forest-gate step 25. The failure preceded scheduled battles and every learned battle or training decision. It is preserved as an authored traversal boundary, not reported as a model failure.

failure.message: Unexpected battle interrupted Route 2 forest-gate route at step 25.

diagnosis.finding: The post-Pokedex teacher had generalized authenticated incidental wild handling only across Route 1. Its next grass corridor still rejected every battle before classifying wild versus trainer or preserving an exit receipt.
diagnosis.uncertainty: The historical failure message did not publish battle type or opponent identity. The repair does not assume them: it admits only battle-state-one encounters on the exact Route 2 map and will still reject a trainer or map drift on replay.
diagnosis.model_boundary: The objective model had selected its singleton first composite, but the chapter completed none. All learned battle, target, training-control, and trainee/venue counters remained zero.

repair.behavior: The Route 1 traversal primitive now accepts an explicit expected map and route label while retaining directional acknowledgement, same-coordinate pre-step encounter handling, finite movement retries, at most sixteen RUN selections per encounter, post-exit stabilization, and exact party/level/HP/max-HP/PP/status/control proofs. Route 1 keeps its compatibility wrapper; only the 43-step Route 2 forest-gate corridor opts into the new map-bound contract.
repair.rom_free_gate: Public-artifact and documentation checks, regenerated-registry check, Ruff, mypy across 128 source modules, and 2,181 tests passed; three integration tests were deselected and one expected failure remained expected.
repair.next_gate: Commit and push the qualified repair, then run a fresh uncounted derived-timing root. Counted v95 remains unopened.
